open_risks: Build A is shipped but INERT. rulesets and rules/branches/main both return [] -- no ruleset, no branch protection, so the merge boundary is fiction today and nothing downstream can be exercised end-to-end.

BLOCKER per 0052: the p/default pin has DRIFTED (canonical d9f73571 vs pinned 39e9e106). security.yml exits 1 at its hash-verify step, so the sast job fails on EVERY push and PR. Do not push this thread's branch until the human rules on the bump.

CORRECTED: the suite is 1217 tests, NOT the 1347 previously recorded. Measured via `npm test` on 2026-07-27, already including this thread's +1 test. Re-verify with `node --test <dir>/*.test.mjs`; a bare directory fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 26 and LOOKS like a real failure.

9 PartialParsing warnings leave regions UNSCANNED in 6 shell hooks including secret-scanner.sh, plus 2 non-code files. RE-VERIFIED unchanged on 2026-07-27 under the drifted ruleset. CI shares this blind spot, so 'clean' means 'clean in what semgrep could parse'.

Pre-existing and NOT fixed (surfaced by the security review): flagHasReachableTruePath's env probe has no left boundary, so `myprocess.env.X_ENABLED` returns true and lintFlags SKIPS the flag. Fails in the suppressing direction. Needs its own item.

0047 is UNENFORCED: delete_branch_on_merge is still false and squash/rebase are still enabled, which is why PR #7 landed squashed (single parent). Config fix: disable squash and rebase repo-side so the merge button can only produce merge commits.

Engine gap nobody owns: if a child PR goes conflicted after retarget, GitHub cannot build the merge ref, no run executes, and the stale green survives. The ship stage treats conclusion=success as GREEN (mitosis.js:4596) without checking mergeability or recency.

Per 0048, whether an empty bypass list binds the repository OWNER on a User-owned repo is UNTESTED, not false. Test empirically after Section 4: open a throwaway PR and attempt a self-merge. The PR #7 self-merge did not test it -- reviews was [] and no ruleset existed.

Give subagents ABSOLUTE worktree paths. A worktree mirrors the parent repo at identical relative paths, and one editor silently opened the PARENT copy of ledger-lint.mjs before correctly stopping. Cost a full re-dispatch.

curl is DENIED to subagents; use python3 urllib. Bash reads of the ledger store are guard-blocked -- use Read or the ledger MCP tools. `timeout` is absent on macOS (exit 127). update_thread caps next_step at 500 chars and each open_risks item at 300.

Worktrees semgrep-pin, boundary-preflight, ci-retarget-rerun (all fully merged) plus the new ledger-lint-guards are prunable, but squash-merge means `git branch --merged` will not list them. Cleanup is destructive; offered, NOT performed.
